findings.problem: D1 message-prefix clause still has no discriminating case: G22.134's wip message is refused by the sha7 regex whether or not :2208 exists
findings.scenario: delete :2208; an add-only commit under feat/s1/ with message def5678 on the pushed tip is allowed without prompt, every G22 case stays green
findings.closure: a G22 case whose message is exactly a 7-hex string with a valid feat/s1/ add expects ask, and turns allow when :2208 is deleted

findings.problem: the line-keyed handover also hands probes outside .claude/ to worktree-kit, whose remedies only cover .claude/
findings.scenario: kit-local project with .gitignore *, !*/, !src/**: worktree-kit DIVERGENCE names .gitignore:1:*, ignored-loop-paths ok, docs/work/ reported nowhere (listed at c2a29f6 and at fix-base)
findings.closure: a DW case with * / !*/ over an untracked kit gives DIVERGENCE ignored-loop-paths listing docs/work/; only probes under .claude/ are handed over

findings.problem: worktree-kit now probes with check-ignore -v, which reports negated matches; the new ! branch in kit_ignore_state decides its verdict and no case exercises it
findings.scenario: .gitignore *, !*/, !.claude/** with nothing tracked: worktree-kit ok today; with :747-748 deleted it reports DIVERGENCE naming !.claude/** and the suite stays green
findings.closure: a DW case with a negated line re-including the kit probe gives ok worktree-kit, and fails with :747-748 removed

findings.problem: the same-repo test requires equal common dirs from BASE_DIR, stricter than project_repo (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, submodules accepted)
findings.scenario: git -C mod worktree add .claude/worktrees/x -b y in a kit-less project submodule was a deny at fix-base, now the generic ask
findings.closure: the comparison uses project_repo's rule and a submodule -C case is denied

findings.problem: ignored-loop-paths ok text still says the whole-.claude line after the Q6 widening
findings.scenario: a .claude/hooks/ line is described as the whole-.claude line
findings.closure: the summary names the line worktree-kit reports

findings.scenario: .claude/hooks/* then *.sh: hooks appears under both checks
findings.closure: both use the same hooks probe

findings.problem: IGNORE_SOURCE is greedy, a pattern holding :digits: splits at the wrong colon
findings.scenario: the line id never equals the owned line, the probe is reported twice
findings.closure: the source split is non-greedy on file:line

findings.problem: IN73 loosened to contains app/alembic instead of before plus app/alembic
findings.scenario: a wire that drops other entries passes
findings.closure: IN73 compares protected_dirs to before plus app and alembic

findings.problem: SR15 skipped as root counts nothing
findings.scenario: a root runner is green with F2 unproved
findings.closure: the skip is counted and reported

findings.problem: no case for the no-depth-2-listdir guard
findings.scenario: deleting the depth == 0 guard stays green

findings.problem: DW12 slices the row with grep -A8
findings.scenario: a ninth evidence line breaks the negative assertion
findings.closure: the row is sliced to the next row header

findings.problem: DW11 does not assert the hand-over summary
findings.scenario: an ok reached through the tracked branch passes

findings.problem: PV5w reuses one id for two assertions
findings.scenario: a failure does not say which half failed
